searchText: Anyone got an Etherscan API key? please stop asking this in multiple channels. <@!388751025789468672> Well it's a reorg between the same block, so it should be impossible So for context <@!360491619402776577> our ropsten nodes are archive nodes so I'm trying to avoid syncing them from genesis if at all possible, so was hoping `debug.setHead` would be able to force a reorg to the new chain I'll see if adding a `--whitelist` entry for the new block 538 helps It should be, if not than you need to wait until our chain overtakes the old chain You could also connect to me directly, dming you my enode also trying again with `--whitelist=10679538=0x569dccc25294768c23249db843ef7156e8e7c6c94cb82cd84a833f9c3e1d72e5` to see if that helps ^ ok between the whitelist option and adding you as a peer it seems to be on the new chain now 🎉 . This was actually just a throwaway test node that was fast sycned I'll try again on a "real" archive node after I grab some lunch. Thanks for helping out! <@!153017054545444864> luckily this node was fast synced but ages ago so it's basically been in full sync mode for several months, and most of our testnet user-facing nodes are archive nodes
